name: Skyblock QoL: Aetheria Fabric Port
description: Unofficial, incremental Minecraft 1.21 Fabric port of Aetheria. Includes a dedicated in-game settings GUI, Mining trackers with separate Powder/Pristine per-gem quality breakdowns, adjustable Gold Tracker units and rates, and filters, Fetchur, HOTM tooltip, Commission Highlight, Pickobulus Preview, Ghost Tracker, Dungeon timers and split tracking, boss/Blood highlights, cached Dungeon data, rectangular/L-shaped room detection, secret markers, an adjustable Dungeon map, a clickable Spirit Leap/InfiniLeap menu, SkyBlock item ID tooltips, a custom block selection highlight, and a Current Pet HUD.
